actions.noAtRisk: Nothing in the queue is at risk
actions.noItemsPastGrace: No items have passed their grace period yet

archiveHold.desc: These may not be downloadable again, so automatic processing leaves them alone. Archive one to keep it for good, or choose Delete anyway.

archivePaused.desc_one: Queued items without a verdict stay held, so nothing is deleted on a guess. Checks resume on their own once the indexers answer again.
archivePaused.desc_other: Queued items without a verdict stay held, so nothing is deleted on a guess. Checks resume on their own once the indexers answer again.
archivePaused.title: Archive checks paused

arrWarning.bannerDesc: Deletion requires Sonarr or Radarr to remove files from disk. Items can be queued but won't be processed until a service is set up.
arrWarning.modalDesc: Items will be marked as deleted in Prunerr but files won't be removed from disk. Set up Sonarr or Radarr in Settings first.
arrWarning.title: Sonarr/Radarr not configured

deleteAllModal.title: Delete All Items Now
deleteAllModal.warning: This will permanently delete all items in the queue, ignoring grace periods.

deleteNowModal.background: The deletion runs in the background. Keep using Prunerr; progress shows on this row and in the sidebar, and the outcome lands in the Activity log.
deleteNowModal.title: Delete Now
deleteNowModal.warning: This will immediately and permanently delete this item, bypassing the grace period.
deleteNowModal.willResetSeerr: Will reset in Seerr for re-request

empty.description: No items are currently marked for deletion. Browse your library to queue items for cleanup, or set up rules to automate the process.
empty.title: Queue is empty

header.subtitle: Items marked for deletion with grace period countdown
header.title: Deletion Queue

panel.intro: Deletions run in the background. A large file on network storage can take Sonarr or Radarr several minutes; the app stays usable meanwhile and the outcome lands here and in the Activity log.
panel.nothingActive: Nothing is being deleted right now.
panel.polling: (live updates paused; refreshing every few seconds)
panel.title: Deletion jobs

toast.failedMsg: See the deletion jobs panel for details
toast.reconciledMsg: "{{title}}" was already gone in {{service}}; removed from the queue

processModal.title: Process Deletion Queue
processModal.warning: This will delete items that have passed their grace period.

protectAtRisk.title: Protect At-Risk Items
protectAtRisk.undo: Archived titles are listed on the Protected page; Unarchive there puts one back under the rules.
protectAtRisk.warning: Every queued title Archive judged at risk will be archived: protected for good and taken out of the queue. Nothing is deleted.

row.deleteNowDisabled: Configure Sonarr/Radarr in Settings to enable deletion

toasts.archivedMsg: "{{title}}" is protected and out of the queue.
toasts.deleteAnywayMsg: "{{title}}" will be deleted when its grace period ends.
